local_context.value: Town settled 1911, incorporated 1925, elevation 213 ft (highest of the nine Polk locations); humid subtropical. April 2024 referendum kept town status. SR 17 runs through the centre.

neighborhoods.value: PARTIAL, listing-site sources only (not official): Ridge of Dundee, The Ridge at Swan Lake, Lake Ruth Estates, Mabel Loop Ridge. County-record names also include Bluffs Dundee, Crystal Lake Preserve, Dell Lake Village.

place_entities.value: PARTIAL: Dundee Town Hall and Library; Lake Marie Park (listing-site mention only); Ridge Scenic Highway (SR 17). Fewer than 3 verified.

permit_office.value: Town of Dundee Development Services Department, 124 Dundee Road, (863) 438-8330 ext. 223 or 438-8335 (town pages differ). CO requests: co-info@townofdundee.com.
